actor.description: Recorded actor identity, not host-authenticated authority.

file.description: A staged file relative to the work directory. The consumer verifies its actual bytes against sha256.

relativePath.description: A slash-separated file path relative to the work directory; no absolute path, dot segment, parent traversal, drive prefix or backslash.

context.description: Supporting notes and reference files used to understand the task, separate from its inputs. Empty collections explicitly mean no extra context. Context does not grant additional execution authority.
context.title: Request context

decision.description: .works/<workId>/decisions/<id>.json: an attributed decision on an exact work revision and subject digest. Identity and authority are not authenticated by this schema.
decision.title: Decision

evidence.description: .works/<workId>/evidence/<id>.json: artifact metadata. Existence, actual digest and evidentiary relevance require separate checks.
evidence.title: Evidence

index.description: Version 1 of the proposed .works document format. A document must match exactly one kind. This contract does not migrate or reinterpret legacy session records.
index.title: Works document contract

inputs.description: The prompts and files the request asks the skill to act on. At least one prompt or file is required.
inputs.title: Request inputs

output.description: One produced output. Text is inline; commits identify a repository and full object ID; images and other files bind persisted artifacts. Output metadata alone does not prove correctness or publication.
output.title: Response output

request.description: .works/<workId>/requests/<id>.json: prompts and files to act on, with supporting context kept separate, against one work revision. This record alone grants no execution permission.
request.title: Request

response.description: .works/<workId>/responses/<id>.json: typed outputs produced for one request. Optional verification observations describe their checks separately; delivering an output is not a claim that the work is proved complete.

feedbackRound.description: Completed feedback-and-repair rounds for this request. Initial candidate is round zero; the caller maintains truthful history.

response.title: Response

work.description: .works/<id>/work.json: goal, declared scope, acceptance criteria and current lifecycle.
work.title: Work

claude.via: Claude Code Read, Glob and Grep

onFail.instruction: Request the exact frozen peer snapshot.

criteria.stopWhen: Stop after two feedback rounds, repeated missing proof, changed frozen scope or unavailable read capability. Done requires exact original evidence for every goal and repository head.

purpose: Independently verify a coordinator's digest-frozen peer portfolio from original terminal session evidence and exact delivered repository heads.

request.description: Supply exactly one digest-bound peer snapshot containing the frozen task set, exact child goals, owned scopes, coordinator done-when mapping, session evidence locations and repository heads. Ordinary messages are not accepted as proof.
request.title: workflow.verify request

response.description: A done response contains one portfolio report whose peer set, exact goals, owned scopes, original goal evidence and delivered repository heads match the frozen snapshot.
response.title: workflow.verify response

scope: Read-only portfolio verification. Messages may locate proof but are never proof. The operator does not change peer sessions, worktrees, repositories, ledgers or task state and does not import copied or inferred success.

calls.purpose: Read and hash the frozen peer snapshot.

steps.instruction: Read the request and its one digest-frozen peer snapshot. Require the exact task set, child goals, owned scopes, coordinator done-when map, declared original session locations and repository boundaries. Do not accept messages or unbound locations as evidence.
produces: Frozen peer and coordinator obligation inventory.

calls.purpose: Read original session records and evidence manifests.

steps.instruction: For each peer, read only its declared original live terminal session or verified close-success bundle. Verify exact frozen goal, solo topology, terminal state, each original goal ledger proof and accepted evidence. Treat ordinary task messages only as locators.

calls.purpose: Read exact repository heads, ancestry and evidence paths.

steps.instruction: Resolve every declared repository boundary and verify its evidence at the exact current head with valid ancestry. Keep repository proofs separate; never union evidence from different heads into a delivery no peer produced.
Reread the snapshot and evidence hashes, map every coordinator done-when line to one proved peer goal, and identify concrete missing, stale or mismatched proof without modifying any peer.
produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

calls.purpose: Present the exact peer-to-goal and repository proof map.

steps.instruction: Write and validate the response with the portfolio report, observations and review results. A missing peer proof returns blocked or mismatch and is never inferred from peer status or conversation text.

validate.failurePolicy: Report the exact peer, goal or head whose original proof is missing or stale. Re-read only newly supplied evidence within the bounded feedback loop; never modify a peer to make verification pass.

review.instruction: Confirm the peer set, exact child goals, owned scopes and coordinator done-when map equal the digest-frozen snapshot with no missing, extra or reassigned peer.
Resolve each peer only through its declared original live session or verified close-success bundle; messages, copied receipts and inferred status may locate but never replace proof.
Verify every original child goal has accepted evidence bound to the frozen goal and terminal state, and every coordinator done-when line has an owning proved peer.
For every delivered repository boundary, verify the declared evidence at the exact current repository head and valid ancestry. Do not combine evidence from different heads into a synthetic delivery.
